config.trinkets-tooltip.min_width.toolti: Columns per page, or per screen when the scrollbar is on.
config.trinkets-tooltip.max_height.toolt: Rows per page, or rows shown at once when the scrollbar is on.
config.trinkets-tooltip.scrollbar.toolti: Replace the page arrows with a Baubles style scrollbar on the left of the panel. The mouse wheel then scrolls one row at a time.
Left clicking an empty trinket slot opens JEI listing every item that can be equipped there.
